topic: Install the git hooks in the repositories you want covered
detail: SP-045 installs nothing by itself and was never run against a real repository (local_safety). To cover a repository, run `orch guard git-hook --install` in it to preview, then `--install --apply`; for every repository at once, point git's global core.hooksPath at a directory and run `orch guard git-hook --install --apply --hooks-dir <dir>`. `--uninstall --apply` restores the hooks that were there. The hooks run the orch binary that installed them (or orch on PATH).
